about: Answer key for the Contract Agent: financial maintenance covenants in each borrower's agreement in force (as identified by agreements.py). Drafted by Claude Code by reading the covenant sections; every quote is checked against the filing by tests/test_live_edgar.py. Needs human review: set reviewed_by when checked.

excluded.CAR: Agreement in force picked by the rule-based classifier is a fleet financing facility, not the corporate credit agreement
excluded.URI: Same: not the corporate ABL facility

covenants.quote: Holdings will not permit the Consolidated Gross Total Leverage Ratio to exceed 4.70 to 1.00
covenants.note: Gross total leverage; revolver only; tested when revolver usage exceeds 35% of commitments

covenants.quote: the First Lien Net Leverage Ratio as of such day to exceed 2.00:1.00

ADNT.note: Term loan agreement; no maintenance covenant wording anywhere in the document

covenants.quote: shall maintain a Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio (as calculated on a consolidated basis) of at least 1.0 to 1.0
covenants.note: ABL; tested only during a Financial Covenant Trigger Period
Applies only when Available Commitments are below $275,000,000 for five consecutive Business Days

covenants.quote: Permit the Total Net Leverage Ratio as of the last day of a Test Period
covenants.note: 3.50x, or 4.00x for three quarters after a Permitted Acquisition

covenants.quote: the Parent will not permit the Total Net Leverage Ratio as of the end of any fiscal quarter set forth below to exceed the ratio set forth below
covenants.note: Step-down schedule; after the Acquisition Completion Date 4.50x through 31 Mar 2027. Revolver and Term A lenders only

covenants.quote: the Parent will not permit the Cash Interest Expense Coverage Ratio as of the last day of any period of four consecutive fiscal quarters
the ratio of the aggregate of all Borrowed Moneys (for the time being undischarged) to Consolidated Capital to be greater than 0.65
covenants.note: Called Total Leverage Ratio but defined as debt to capital

covenants.quote: the ratio of EBITDA to Consolidated Net Interest Charges

CZR.note: Term loan agreement; no maintenance covenant wording anywhere in the document

covenants.quote: at any time that any Revolving Loans are outstanding, permit the Consolidated Net Senior Secured Leverage Ratio
covenants.note: Tested only while revolving loans are outstanding

covenants.quote: Parent will not permit the aggregate amount of Liquidity at the close of any Business Day to be less than $2,000,000,000

SABR.note: Term loan agreement; no maintenance covenant wording anywhere in the document

covenants.quote: The Borrower shall not permit the Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio for any Test Period to be less than 1.00 to 1.00
covenants.note: Tested only during a Covenant Trigger Period

covenants.quote: Permit the Loan-to-Value Ratio to be greater than or equal to 0.70 to 1.0 at any time
Permit Free Liquidity to be less than $250,000,000 at any time
